title: Sunday · Dog Night, 2018
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Nineteen years. The alley, and over the ridge behind the Lanes' roofline the glow is wider than the year before, drawn in the first tier and not again. The pup, the dumpster, the hand.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the alley at night, the sign mostly dark, and above the roofline the ridge with a warm glow wider than before.

image.prompt: a night alley beneath a mostly dark neon bowling sign with a wooded ridge above the roofline showing a wide warm glow, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Wider

panels.composition: Tier 2: a man and a small three-legged dog walking the alley, the dog ahead.

image.prompt: a man walking a small three-legged dog down a rainy alley at night with the dog ahead, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Walk

panels.composition: Tier 3: the dumpster, the dog's nose to the corner, the man's hand down on his back, the sky not shown.

image.prompt: a small three-legged dog sniffing a dumpster's corner in a rainy alley with a man's hand resting on its back, the sky out of frame, watercolor

panels.name: Hand

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Nineteen. The glow wider (2018); drawn once, then not.
